text: おまえは　たんパン　はいて　ないじゃん

structure.jp: はいて　ないじゃん

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb of putting on clothes says you have them on now; here it is the 'not' form with the い dropped, as in casual speech. はいて ない = 'aren't wearing'.

patterns.name: 〜じゃないか
patterns.explanation: じゃん is a slangy short form of じゃないか, used to point out something obvious with surprise or complaint. はいて ないじゃん = 'hey, you're not even wearing any!'
